options.content:
### Session profile
Summary statistics for the selected session and time range. Includes received samples, scheduled-slot coverage, line-loss episode count, and estimated total observed loss time. Use the time picker at the top right to choose the window; the refresh menu can be set to **Pause** while inspecting a run.

panels.description: Count of scheduled telemetry slots not present between received samples in the selected time range. A sequence reset after reboot is not counted as missing slots.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.session_id != "unassigned" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r._field == "device_sequence") |> group(columns: ["device", "source", "session_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> difference() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value > 1 then r._value - 1 else 0})) |> sum()

panels.title: Missing telemetry slots

panels.description: Largest positive interval between received device uptime values. Intervals spanning a device reboot are excluded.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.session_id != "unassigned" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r._field == "device_uptime_ms") |> group(columns: ["device", "source", "session_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> difference() |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0) |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0}))

panels.title: Largest device sample gap

panels.description: One row per observed line-loss episode. Duration uses device uptime when both edges have it, otherwise collector receipt time. Start and recovery are bounded by telemetry sampling and message gaps; unresolved rows have no confirmed recovery.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_line_loss_events" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "session_id", "source", "status", "start_basis", "loss_duration_ms", "duration_source", "recovered_at", "open_observation_interval_ms", "start_mode", "start_fault", "start_gyro_z_dps", "start_motor_left_applied", "start_motor_right_applied", "recovery_mode", "recovery_fault", "recovery_gyro_z_dps", "recovery_motor_left_applied", "recovery_motor_right_applied"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

panels.title: Line loss episodes

panels.description: Observed line-loss episodes in the selected session and time range, including episodes still open or unresolved at session end.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_line_loss_events" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r._field == "status") |> group() |> count()

panels.title: Line-loss episodes

panels.description: Recovered durations plus observed intervals for losses unresolved at session end. Estimates are bounded by sample cadence and message gaps; an active open episode has no confirmed duration yet.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_line_loss_events" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "loss_duration_ms" or r._field == "open_observation_interval_ms")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.status == "recovered" then r.loss_duration_ms else r.open_observation_interval_ms})) |> group() |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0}))

panels.title: Observed line-loss time

panels.description: Received scheduled telemetry slots as a percentage of inferred slots between samples in the selected time range. Slots before the first observed sample and across a device reboot are not inferable.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.session_id != "unassigned" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r._field == "device_sequence") |> group(columns: ["device", "source", "session_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> reduce(identity: {received: 0.0, missing: 0.0, last: -1.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({received: accumulator.received + 1.0, missing: accumulator.missing + (if accumulator.last >= 0.0 and float(v: r._value) > accumulator.last + 1.0 then float(v: r._value) - accumulator.last - 1.0 else 0.0), last: float(v: r._value)})) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.received + r.missing > 0.0 then r.received / (r.received + r.missing) * 100.0 else 0.0})) |> group() |> mean(column: "_value")
